content.title: Jesus and the God of Israel: God Crucified and Other Studies on the New Testament's Christology of Divine Identity
content.author: Richard Bauckham (Grand Rapids: Eerdmans, 2008)
content.note: Argues that the earliest Christians included Jesus within the unique identity of Israel's one God, for example by applying Isaiah 45:23 to him in Philippians 2.
